title: Quenched Glassy Brazilian Strawberry Stew
description: A funky, glassy-jelly, one-pot Brazilian dish featuring strawberries and a mirepoix base, perfect for a vegan-friendly meal.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in a little water over medium heat until the vegetables are tender.
Add the sliced strawberries, vegan broth, agave nectar, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk the cornstarch with a little water until smooth.
Stir the cornstarch mixture into the pot and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes, or until the stew has thickened.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew cool slightly.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew until it is mostly smooth, or leave it chunky if you prefer.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional sliced strawberries if desired.
